Redefine_Guidelines: Product Requirements should be clearly defined and focus on customer-facing improvements and visible touchpoints.
Requirement threshold/target must be specific and not reference 'Equal or better than Predecessor'.
Functional and experience improvements require measurable metrics.
Channel requests for Feature requirement/Experience & Warranty Improvement to Function owners (Marketing/GxD/TME) for holistic assessment.
Do not include Best Practices in PRD.

Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Challenge: It is difficult for Quality and Marketing to write technical specs or values for subjective requirements.
Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Past_Practice: Use of vague statements like 'equal or better than predecessor'.
Threshold_Target_Guidelines.Proposal: State what the customer expects instead of vague statements; use specific, observable, and measurable outcomes.

Example_Case_1_Tire_Mark.Requirement_From_Customer_Perspective: No visible tire mark on photo media.
Example_Case_1_Tire_Mark.Threshold_Acceptable_to_Ship: Minor tire mark acceptable (metric to be defined with program).
